item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. No notes logged for this today, so that's the gap worth closing. Your day's already stacked with check-ins and grounding moments — good. Medication works the same way: same time, same routine, no relying on memory alone. Before bed tonight, confirm today's doses actually happened, and set tomorrow's up now so morning-you doesn't have to think.
